candidates.change_summary: Replace the body of withdrawAll() so it sends the contract balance to owner by calling withdraw(ownerBalance) instead of withdraw(address(this).balance), causing different behavior if owner is not this contract.
Modify onlyOwner modifier to allow calls from anyone (remove the require), changing who can call withdrawAll and thus observable withdraw behavior.
Replace the transfer to msg.sender with sending to owner, so withdraw sends funds to the stored owner instead of the caller.
Relax onlyOwner to allow any caller (remove the require), so withdraw can be invoked by non-owners and will transfer to msg.sender.
Replace the require on the low-level call result with an unconditional ignore so failed calls no longer revert (removes require), changing post-call state visibility when sendMoney fails.
Invert the require condition so the call must fail (require !success), causing successful calls to revert and changing observed behavior of sendMoney.
Alter onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove require), so sendMoney becomes callable by non-owners and thus observable behavior of who can call sendMoney changes.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender is NOT the owner, so only non-owners can call sendMoney, altering observable access behavior.
